acquisition method: data-dependent acquisition on a Q-Exactive HF-X was carried out using standard proteomic procedures
cleavage agent: protein conformations were then assessed by pulse proteolysis for 1 min with proteinase K (PK; for LiP-MS)
instrument: data-dependent acquisition on a Q-Exactive HF-X was carried out using standard proteomic procedures
labeling: refolded ecPGK was cross-linked with an isotopically heavy form of DSBU
reduction reagent: Preparation of native and refolded ecPGK for LiP-MS and XL-MS was identical except dithiothreitol was used in place of TCEP (in identical concentrations) for LiP-MS studies.
reduction concentration: native dilution buffer [20 mM Hepes-NaOH (pH 7.4), 100 mM NaCl, 2 mM MgCl2, 1.01 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine (TCEP), and 0.06 M GdmCl]
